item.title: KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS
item.description:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Oliver Reed and Vanessa Redgrave, THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Fully restored and presented uncut and unfiltered as Russell always envisioned, the film screens from a stunning, brand new 35mm print.

item.title: Seven
item.description:
Seven, a 1995 American crime thriller directed by David Fincher, follows two detectives, a seasoned veteran named William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) and a rookie, David Mills (Brad Pitt), as they hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives. Director David Fincher and cinematographer Darius Khondji worked with the lab to create a small number of distinctive showcase prints - see one of these rare original CCE Silver Retention 35mm print that provides a deeper black, higher contrast, and added grain.

Data: 1995
Durata: 127 minuti

item.title: Beau Geste
item.description:
Stunning new 35mm print from a gorgeous restoration! Beau Geste thrums with action and drama as a trio of British brothers — future Oscar-winner Ronald Colman, Neil Hamilton forty years before he became Commissioner Gordon on TV's Batman, and the prolific Ralph Forbes — find themselves in the French Foreign Legion and at the mercy of a sadistic commanding officer (Noah Beery). William Powell shines in the supporting cast, eight years before he portrayed Nick Charles in the The Thin Man movie series. One of Paramount Pictures' most popular films of the 1920s, Brenon's epic spectacle inspired multiple sequels, remakes, and, eventually, parodies and, with this monumental restoration, can now reach modern audiences. “To see this on a screen with an audience I believe will be a cinematic treat” - Quentin Tarantino
Cast: Director: Herbert Brenon | Writers: Paul Schofield | Stars: Ronald Colman, Neil Hamilton, Ralph Forbes, Alice Joyce, Mary Brian, Noah Beery
Data: 1926
Durata: 133 minuti
